answered.label: No post in that group matched the exact phrase “first espresso machine under $600”. The consensus below is from its beginner / budget threads. A recurring warning in almost every thread is that the grinder matters as much as, or more than, the machine, and the $600 figure usually does not include a good grinder.
answered.value: No post in that group matched the exact phrase “first espresso machine under $600”. The consensus below is from its beginner / budget threads. A recurring warning in almost every thread is that the grinder matters as much as, or more than, the machine, and the $600 figure usually does not include a good grinder.

answered.label: 1. Breville Bambino / Bambino Plus — the most repeated pick
1. Breville Bambino / Bambino Plus — the most repeated pick
answered.value: 1. Breville Bambino / Bambino Plus — the most repeated pick

answered.label: Reasons members gave: 3-second heat-up, ready to use quickly, compact, good shot quality for a beginner, and automatic milk frothing on the Plus. Usually quoted around $350, or under $400, with the Plus on sale at $400 vs $500 in one Facebook post.
answered.value: Reasons members gave: 3-second heat-up, ready to use quickly, compact, good shot quality for a beginner, and automatic milk frothing on the Plus. Usually quoted around $350, or under $400, with the Plus on sale at $400 vs $500 in one Facebook post.
